propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped, selecting provider behavior by matching provider-name strings, and has no AWS Bedrock path.
A provider_factory + ModelProfile seam should replace name-string branching, with all Provider objects constructed only in providers.py.
Anthropic and Bedrock are first-class tiers with full-fidelity retry/timeout/caching parity; all other providers go through one best-effort OpenAI-compatible builder.
_pai_check_config wrongly refuses base_url/api_key while docs claim REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL/API_KEY/MODEL_PROVIDER work, so documentation is false and the refusal must be retired.
The signed verdict sidecar's model field must widen to structured provenance recording provider, endpoint host, and support tier.

The 8-10 change stack is physically invalid mid-chain because it grows runner.py past the 800-LOC cap before splitting it; reordering is impossible and a feature-branch landing strategy is recommended.
